verdict.rationale: Milvus Lite/Standalone docs mention 'vector CRUD operations' as a core feature, implying users can delete entities/collections, and RBAC/multi-tenancy docs show some data-governance controls, but the evidence pack has no explicit documentation of deletion APIs, TTL/expiry, purge/compaction policies, or retention controls. An older community comment even notes vector deletion was unsupported in early versions, though this predates current CRUD claims and isn't a concrete current-version contradiction. missing for 10: explicit delete/drop API docs, data retention/TTL policy documentation, compliance-oriented deletion guarantees, independent confirmation of deletion behavior.
